links.outcome: Error rate and hallucinations of retrieval-grounded ChatENT versus base ChatGPT4.0 on OHNS exam questions
links.effect: ChatENT outperformed ChatGPT4.0 with 58.4% (Canadian Royal College sample questions) and 26.0% (US board practice questions) error reduction; fewer hallucinations and greater consistency.
links.quote: ChatENT showed enhanced performance in the analysis and interpretation of OHNS information, outperforming ChatGPT4.0 in both the Canadian Royal College OHNS sample examination questions challenge and the US board practice questions challenge, with a 58.4% and 26.0% error reduction, respectively.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatENT by comparing ChatGPT-4 with and without retrieval-augmented generation on Otolaryngology-Head and Neck Surgery examination questions, specifically measuring hallucination reduction and accuracy.

primary.practice: retrieval grounding added to an existing tool
